description: This Java class 'ChangeLogVersions' defines and holds lists of Liquibase snapshot and update version strings used for tracking available database change logs in the OpenMRS project. It provides getter methods to access these version lists, which need to be kept in sync with actual change log files.

classes.name: ChangeLogVersions
classes.description: Class that maintains lists of Liquibase snapshot and update versions for OpenMRS, ensuring synchronization with change log files.

methods.name: getSnapshotVersions
methods.description: Returns the list of Liquibase snapshot versions.

methods.name: getUpdateVersions
methods.description: Returns the list of Liquibase update versions.
